_comment: Single source of truth for environment mapping. Every CI/CD workflow resolves the target workspace, database and deploy gate through this file (scripts/resolve_env.py). host/token are secret NAMES, not values; the workflows declare each referenced secret and select by name at runtime. database = Lakebase branch = the state CD applies to. Deploy uses bundle target = environment key (databricks.yml targets dev/qa/stage/prod). Moving an environment to another workspace or database edits this file only.
